|lore=Poorly equipped Rebels must rely on clandestine strikes against the massive Imperial military. Computer ‘slicing’ and system tampering have proven most effective.
|game_text=Target an opponent’s device or non-superlaser weapon card. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny -X < target’s destiny number, where X = the number of your spies on table. OR Cancel the targeting of a [[Permanent Weapon]] weapon at same site as your spy.
|printings={{Card versions/Sabotage (A New Hope)}}
|notes=The 2006 slip states the per-spy destiny reduction as X and uses the permanent weapon icon in the alternative. The [[Sabotage (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Sabotage (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
